name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for SaaS and cloud service providers, covering subscription, data, and support terms.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard agreement for early-access design partner programs, covering product access, feedback, and IP ownership.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper standard SLA defining uptime targets, response time commitments, and service credit remedies.

description: Common Paper standard agreement for professional services engagements, covering SOWs, deliverables, payment, and IP assignment.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard partnership agreement for business collaboration, covering obligations, trademark license, and revenue sharing.
